notes: Browser appearance copy: static rest poses, simple kinematic interactions; no heavy native cloth/rigid simulation.
All modeled receiver closures use a consistent rounded black/red case and persistent slotted metal tongue.
Cable rest paths remain still until an endpoint is manipulated.
Physics settings in historical offline sources are unchanged.
Every buckle links to separately exported soft webbing; fixed mounting lugs and rings remain on the cabin.
Every steel tongue includes a short black webbing loop threaded around its crossbar; this persistent tab moves with the tongue.

V4 cot closures use separate fixed receiver-side bands and continuous frame-to-steel-slot tongue-side ribbons. The loose spare waist pair starts open. Release is attachment-driven, not a detached short tab.

v4: ECG ceiling straps and receivers remain fixed while the lower tongue-side net releases. Cargo uses the source-observed opposite orientation: its wall-loop and tongue stay fixed while the receiver, red button and connected upper-left net end release. Original lower and wall mounting rows retain zero release weight.
Upper cargo pouches rigidly prepared upright from original Blender meshes; labels retained, contents not inferred.
